claims.statement: The openwiki/ tree is split between a public subtree whose paths mirror mkdocs.yml (sixteen pages plus an auto-generated Home at openwiki/index.md) and an agent-only subtree under openwiki/testing/, plus openwiki/README.md, openwiki/quickstart.md, openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, and openwiki/.claims/. The public paths are exactly the eighteen entries listed in scripts/publish_openwiki_to_docs.py as PUBLIC_PATHS.

openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md is the user-authored brief and is not regenerated by OpenWiki on --init or --update; it is also excluded from publishing because it appears in SKIP_NAMES in scripts/publish_openwiki_to_docs.py.

scripts/publish_openwiki_to_docs.py is the bridge from openwiki/ to docs/: it strips a leading OKF/YAML front matter block, rewrites [text](href) and HTML href= URLs that point at openwiki/... (with prefixes /openwiki/, openwiki/, ./openwiki/, ../openwiki/) into MkDocs-relative paths from the destination directory, and skips files that match SKIP_NAMES or live under SKIP_DIR_PREFIXES (.claims/, testing/, api/, assets/, stylesheets/).

scripts/publish_openwiki_to_docs.py detects OpenWiki auto-generated index pages whose first heading is '# Files' (or whose headings contain both 'files' and 'directories') and skips them; this is why openwiki/index.md is intentionally not copied to docs/, even though index.md is in PUBLIC_PATHS and sits at the public Home route.

GitHub Actions flows generated pages to GitHub Pages in three steps: the OpenWiki Update workflow (.github/workflows/openwiki-update.yml) runs openwiki_update.sh on push to main, workflow_dispatch, and an 08:00 UTC cron, then calls scripts/publish_openwiki_to_docs.py to copy public paths into docs/, then opens a pull request on branch openwiki/update via peter-evans/create-pull-request with paths openwiki, docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. The Deploy Documentation workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml) builds with mkdocs build --strict on changes to docs/**, mkdocs.yml, or its own path and uploads the site/ artifact to GitHub Pages.

The OpenWiki Update workflow uses OpenRouter :free models; scripts/openwiki_pick_model.py ranks ids by tool-calling support, then Artificial Analysis coding_index when present, else context_length, then created, and scripts/openwiki_update.sh retries the next model on 429/402/rate-limit, 403/404, agentic-harness blocks, and model-unavailable errors, sleeping retry_after_seconds or X-RateLimit-Reset (capped at 90s) on 429. The OPENROUTER_API_KEY repository secret is required.
Generated openwiki/ and docs/ changes are never pushed straight to main; branch protection enforces a pull request on the openwiki/update branch as the merge gate between generation and deployment.
GitHub Pages publishes from docs/ using the existing mkdocs.yml nav; openwiki/ is not a Wiki tab and there is no /wiki/ URL.
